name: What Is This?
description: Point your camera at a plant, animal, object, dish or landmark and your AI tells you what it is, with fun facts and a useful tip.
prompt: A camera app that identifies whatever you point it at using the AI: name, kind, confidence, a short description, surprising facts, a practical tip and a warning when something is toxic or dangerous. It can read the answer aloud, tell you more, and keeps a gallery of your discoveries.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Apunta la cámara a una planta, un animal, un objeto, un plato o un monumento y tu IA te dice qué es, con curiosidades y un consejo útil.
